sideA.text:
THIS PACKAGE INCLUDES:
• 4 cards • 3 sticker cards
• 15 Supply cubes

RECON REPORT

Eerie. Just like our homes. Same design...same layout. Is this our future, empty cities rusting into the ocean?

Searching for a few days revealed some breakthroughs—portable lab technology enabling supplies to be generated in the field and some experimental medicine to inoculate populations.

These cities will remain inoculated for months—buying us some time—before it slowly wears off.

We also found a cache of supplies which means more supplies each month for the rest of the year.

Read both sides of this card then keep it in the reserve.
P6-01a

sideB.text:
RIGHT NOW!

• Name this new haven.
• Take the Portable Antiviral Lab cards found in this package and add 1 to your hand. Add the other 2 to the Player discard pile.
• Take the 15 Supply cubes from this package and add them to the stockpile.
P6-01b

rules: Read both sides, then keep this card in the reserve.
Add 1 Portable Antiviral Lab to your hand and the other 2 to the Player discard pile.
Add the 15 Supply cubes from this package to the stockpile. These are new cubes, not cubes moved from the reserve.
mechanics.notes: The permanent extra supplies each month are the Area 10 +15 sticker and Rule B, not a second line on this card.
